deferred: Between this slice and s5/s6 the runtime doctrine an agent reads actively contradicts the enum, in the direction of suppression. plugins/spec-loop/skills/escalation-gate/SKILL.md:50 heads its list 'SURFACE to human (only these five triggers)', :93 states 'There are exactly five JUDGMENT triggers; an over-scope flag is not a sixth', and :119 says the bar stays at 'exactly the five triggers above'; README.md:99 and references/risk-tiers.md:86 repeat the count. This slice makes slice_wave_contract_base.ANSWERABLE_TRIGGERS six members wide. The plan is right that this prose is unpinned and right to assign it to s5/s6, so this is not a defect in s2 — but it is a real exposure if s5/s6 do not land: the escalation-gate skill is the document consulted before surfacing an escalation, and 'only these five' is an instruction not to surface the sixth. Worth carrying as an explicit dependency on s5/s6 rather than as incidental prose cleanup, so a partial run does not publish a doctrine that forbids the trigger this run exists to add.
